_comment: AiBoO Linux Sentinel - optional tuning file. Everything here is OPTIONAL: the agent has sane built-in defaults. Change a value and restart the agent.

_thresholds.ssh_fail_threshold: how many failed SSH logons from one IP/user before one HIGH 'brute force' alert (default 5)
_thresholds.ssh_fail_window: seconds that must contain those failures (default 300)
_thresholds.web_fail_threshold: failed web logins from one IP before a HIGH alert (default 10)
_thresholds.scan_404_threshold: 404 answers from one IP before 'endpoint scanning' (default 20)
_thresholds.error_burst_threshold: failing HTTP responses from one IP before 'flood' (default 50)
